§6MOX Fuel§f

§aUranium plus plutonium. Mid-range in most reactors, but the RBMK loves it.§f

MOX Fuel (Mixed Oxide Fuel) is a mixture of §e2/3rds§f uranium and §e1/3rd§f plutonium fuel. In most reactors it's mid-range, but in the §bRBMK§f it's considerably strong for its cost.

Composition: §e2/3§f Medium Enriched U-235 Fuel + §e1/3§f Pu-239.

Crafting (shapeless): Nugget = 4 Uranium Fuel Nuggets + 2 Pu-239 Nuggets = 1 MOX Fuel Billet. Billet = 2 Uranium Fuel Billets + 1 Pu-239 Billet = §e3§f MOX Fuel Billets.

ZIRNOX performance: §e75§f heat/tick (stronger than plutonium), §e165k§f ticks lifespan, radiation goes from §e2.5§f to §e150§f RAD/s.

RBMK: §e1B§f yield, logarithmic function, §e7.5§f TU per flux.

Recycling via PUREX: Depleted MOX = Reactor Grade Pu Nugget + Tc-99 Nugget + 3 Nuclear Waste.

§ePS:§f The billet recipe gives §e3§f billets instead of 1. Extremely efficient for bulk production.
